title: PeriaTrace: Tooth-Level Grounding Diagnosis and Patient-Facing Explanations from Periapical Radiographs
abstract: arXiv:2611.23012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Periapical radiographs (PRs) are central to endodontic diagnosis, but interpreting them and preparing reports are time-consuming. Technical language can limit patients' understanding, while existing automated methods often lack tooth-level links between findings and image evidence. We present PeriaTrace, a three-stage framework integrating tooth-level diagnosis, visually grounded report generation, and patient-friendly explanations and care recommendations. PeriaTrace was developed and evaluated using 12,877 PRs from an internal dataset and two external clinical cohorts. translated_title: PeriaTrace：基于根尖周X光片的牙级定位诊断与面向患者的解释
translated_abstract: 根尖周X光片（PRs）是牙髓病诊断的核心，但解读这些影像和撰写报告非常耗时。专业术语可能限制患者的理解，而现有的自动化方法往往缺乏检查发现与图像证据之间的牙级关联。我们提出了PeriaTrace，这是一个三阶段框架，集成了牙级诊断、视觉定位报告生成以及面向患者的友好解释和护理建议。PeriaTrace使用来自内部数据集和两个外部临床队列的12,877张根尖周X光片进行开发和评估。在内部评估中，它取得了85.35%的宏观Dice系数、0.6504的BLEU-4分数、牙齿定位与国际牙科联合会（FDI）编号识别联合任务的94.37% F1分数，以及77.93%的定位标签F1分数。在两个外部队列中，资深牙髓病专家认为分别有91.16%和84.52%的报告适合保留或仅需修改。
tldr: 该论文提出PeriaTrace三阶段框架，能够从根尖周X光片中实现牙级定位诊断、生成带有视觉定位的自动化报告，并提供面向患者的通俗解释与护理建议，在内部和外部临床数据上均表现出色。
en_tdlr: This paper presents PeriaTrace, a three-stage framework that enables tooth-level grounded diagnosis, visually grounded report generation, and patient-friendly explanations from periapical radiographs, achieving strong performance on both internal and external clinical cohorts.
